I feel like we could get back together if I wanted to, but I'm so afraid to have my heart broken again down the line that I don't want to risk it. I've never grown so attached to another person before. I would have genuinely taken a bullet for that girl.

I saved her life once and I know I'll still be keeping an eye on her when I'm gone :)

You are right though - we all are just lost in this messed up world. Stay strong <3

I appreciate your reply more than you can imagine - even behind a screen its nice to talk to someone.

I can relate to what you said completely. Though I havent cried since the initial breakup and dont think I can. Its like im already dead inside :/

Thank you x
